name: 自然红润服帖单色腮红款
description: 单色圆盒腮红，粉质细腻服帖，轻扫即得自然红润妆感

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant rows, sakura blush pink #F6D7DA for benefit and infographic screens, warm off-white #FAF2EF for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone pedestal #EFE7E1 and neutral matte board
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons with rounded pill callouts, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the open round compact across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm rosy color-cosmetics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sakura blush pink #F6D7DA, rose-red accent #D6455E and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with rounded pill callouts; clean high-end color-cosmetics photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, open round compact facing the camera, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, gentle contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The open round compact standing upright on its base, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible with the mirrored lid open. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a gentle contact shadow grounding the compact. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. Generous clean margin around the product, no extra whitespace decoration. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达红润气色的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, compact on a low round pedestal at the right
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle contact shadow, subtle warm accent glow on the powder pan
shots.background: sakura blush pink #F6D7DA with a soft rounded panel
shots.props: one thin-line pill callout placeholder and a small sphere-dot icon
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 35-40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The open compact shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on a low round pedestal at the right, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Background sakura blush pink #F6D7DA with one soft rounded panel behind the product, soft front-left key light and a subtle warm glow on the powder pan. On the left, one rounded pill label reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with a small sphere-dot icon, plus two empty pill outlines as proof placeholders. Generous negative space on the left 35-40% for copy. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented efficacy claims or numbers, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大面色暗沉无气的日常痛点，引出腮红带来的红润改观
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical straight-on camera and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and dull; right panel soft and warm with a gentle glow
shots.background: soft warm neutral #F3E7E4 on both panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on camera and framing. Left panel: an abstract dull, tired-looking cheek patch rendered in muted beige-pink tones under flat light, conveying a washed-out complexion without showing a real face. Right panel: the same abstract cheek patch with a healthy rosy glow, and {product} resting beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background soft warm neutral #F3E7E4 on both panels, soft even light. Two short labels reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, one per panel, plus one empty pill outline as a proof placeholder. Each panel's subject occupies 40-50%. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated before-and-after skin results, no invented claims or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入真实上妆时刻，让买家想象轻扫后红润的自己
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level candid framing, cropped below the chin, focus on the hand and brush at the cheek
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle natural shadow
shots.props: an open {product} held low in frame and a fluffy wooden-handle blush brush, not covering the face
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, lifestyle context fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: a generic model cropped below the chin and photographed from a slight 3/4 eye-level candid angle, one hand sweeping a fluffy wooden-handle blush brush along the cheekbone, the open {product} held low in the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle natural shadows. Warm off-white dressing-table backdrop #FAF2EF with a hint of a mirror edge. The product and hand occupy 40-50% of the frame. No extra whitespace, natural lifestyle framing. Negative: no recognizable face or identifiable likeness, no visible eyes or mouth, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered vanity.

shots.intent: 用微距粉质肌理证明细腻服帖的粉感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the pressed powder surface, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the right revealing the fine pressed-powder texture
shots.props: a brush tip touching the pan edge
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the pressed powder pan surface with a fine embossed texture and a soft brush tip touching the pan edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Soft skimming light from the right revealing the fine pressed-powder texture. Neutral matte board background #EFE7E1. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Minimal whitespace, the texture is the whole point. One small thin-line label reading 「{selling_point_2}」 at the lower corner. Negative: no blurry subject, no fabricated ingredient claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no floating dust clutter.

shots.intent: 一眼看全色号选择，让买家挑到自己的那支红
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, three open compacts in a row
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: three small empty pill labels under each compact
shots.whitespace: narrow even gutters between items, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant row of {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, three open round compacts in an even row showing three shades in rose red #C4485E, plum #A34A6E and warm terracotta #B96A3F. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Consistent identical angle and even high-key flat lighting across all three, no dramatic shadow. Clean white background #FFFFFF. Small empty pill labels under each compact, one reading 「{callout_3}」 and two left blank as placeholders. The row occupies 60-70% of the frame with narrow even gutters, no extra whitespace. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no shade color drift, no invented shade names or numbers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用行动按钮把种草情绪转化为下单动作
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level group shot, compact centered with its lid open
shots.lighting: even soft studio light with a slightly punchier warm accent, gentle contact shadows
shots.background: rose-red accent panel #D6455E with soft white halo
shots.props: one rounded CTA button placeholder and two small sphere-dot icons
shots.whitespace: generous negative space above the product for the closing copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The open compact centered, straight-on eye-level group shot, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Rose-red accent panel background #D6455E with a soft white halo behind the product, even soft studio light with a slightly punchier warm accent and gentle contact shadows. Above the product, one short headline reading 「{selling_point_3}」 and a rounded CTA button reading 「{callout_4}」, plus two small sphere-dot icons and one empty pill outline as a proof placeholder. Generous negative space framed above the product for the closing copy. Negative: no invented discounts, countdowns or claims, no real price numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1 粉底色开盖圆盒腮红立于大理石圆台、粉底樱粉背景、卖点胶囊标签与球点图标；屏2 樱粉底六宫格卖点信息图（全部为重复占位文案）；屏3 白底模特持刷上妆图（可辨识面容）；屏4 三条横向色号排装卡（红/梅/古铜三色）交替排布；屏5 白底模特持刷场景图＋产品参数区起始；屏6 参数标签卡与会员二维码角标。品类判定：主品为开盖圆盒单色压粉腮红，屏1/屏4 色号排装与屏5 参数区为硬证据，源夹名『洗护』与文件名『晒红』均为误导，判为美妆彩妆/颊部（晒红实为腮红）。已剥离：原品牌拼名字标、会员二维码角标与促销贴片、模特面容（场景镜一律改为颈部以下裁切或背影式构图）、原文案原句（换为 selling_point/callout 占位与空胶囊位）、参数区具体数值（原页本就为空白模板，保持空占位）。
